mechanism.claim: After an actual extreme BTC perpetual funding settlement, a completed four-hour price move opposite the funding sign accompanied by open-interest contraction is adverse crowd liquidation rather than carry collection; during elevated variation, follow the deleveraging direction for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed post-settlement four-hour BTC return, necessarily opposite the funding-rate sign
mechanism.why_distinct: HVAFC combines the exact settled funding polarity with subsequent endpoint OI contraction and adverse price displacement. Funding-volatility unwind conditions on pre-settlement alignment and post-settlement volatility reset without OI; OI purge ignores funding; funding/OI rotation uses premium state. HVAFC uses no cross-alt spread, fitted outcome, prior event, or control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: absolute settled funding and completed post-settlement variation must occupy causal upper regimes while falling OI proves inventory exit
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: actual funding timestamps delayed four hours by adverse price/OI confirmation are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.event: actual Binance BTCUSDT USD-M funding settlement S with finite strict-nonzero rate known at S
features.funding_extremeness: strict-prior midrank of abs(rate) over at most 270 earlier settlements, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.post_settlement_return: log(last close/first open), strict nonzero and sign=-sign(funding rate)
features.oi_path: 49 exact positive period=5m OI observations S through S+4h
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared 48 five-minute log(close/open) returns), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid settlement windows whose S+4h availability precedes current S+4h, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligibility: funding extreme, adverse price direction, OI contraction, and variation gate

clock.feature_available: S+4h after all price and OI observations complete
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: current settlement precedes entry and is not earned; later exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: actual funding polarity followed by four-hour adverse return and endpoint OI contraction under elevated variation

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no funding rank, window, OI definition, variation rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.
